import json

import pytest

def test_client_id(db_session):
    from src.backend.models.client import Client

    c = Client(
        name="Test Client",
        code=f"TC-{uuid.uuid4().hex[:6]}",
        primary_email="test@example.com",
    )
    db_session.add(c)
    db_session.commit()
    db_session.refresh(c)
    return c.id


@pytest.fixture(scope="function")
def test_project_id(db_session, test_client_id, admin_user):
    from src.backend.models.project import Project

    p = Project(
        client_id=test_client_id,
        name="Test Project",
        code=f"TP-{uuid.uuid4().hex[:6]}",
        pm_id=admin_user.id,
    )
    db_session.add(p)
    db_session.commit()
    db_session.refresh(p)
    return p.id


def _make_boq_json(items):
    return json.dumps(items).encode("utf-8")


def _boq_item(line, desc="Item", unit="nos", qty=1, rate=100):
    return {
        "line_number": line,
        "description": desc,
        "unit": unit,
        "quantity": qty,
        "rate": rate,
    }


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_list_versions(authed_pm_client, test_project_id):
    items = _make_boq_json([_boq_item(1), _boq_item(2)])
    r = await authed_pm_client.post(
        f"/api/projects/{test_project_id}/boqs",
        files={"file": ("boq1.json", items, "application/json")},
    )
    assert r.status_code == 201

    items2 = _make_boq_json([_boq_item(1, "Item A"), _boq_item(2, "Item B"), _boq_item(3, "Item C")])
    r2 = await authed_pm_client.post(
        f"/api/projects/{test_project_id}/boqs",
        files={"file": ("boq2.json", items2, "application/json")},
    )
    assert r2.status_code == 201

    r = await authed_pm_client.get(f"/api/projects/{test_project_id}/boqs")
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = r.json()
    assert data["total"] == 2
    assert len(data["items"]) == 2


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_version_detail(authed_pm_client, test_project_id):
    items = _make_boq_json([_boq_item(1, "Concrete"), _boq_item(2, "Steel")])
    r = await authed_pm_client.post(
        f"/api/projects/{test_project_id}/boqs",
        files={"file": ("boq.json", items, "application/json")},
    )
    boq_id = r.json()["id"]

    r = await authed_pm_client.get(f"/api/boqs/{boq_id}")
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = r.json()
    assert len(data["items"]) == 2
    assert data["items"][0]["description"] == "Concrete"
    assert data["items"][1]["description"] == "Steel"


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_version_items_pagination(authed_pm_client, test_project_id):
    items = _make_boq_json([_boq_item(i, f"Item {i}") for i in range(1, 26)])
    r = await authed_pm_client.post(
        f"/api/projects/{test_project_id}/boqs",
        files={"file": ("boq.json", items, "application/json")},
    )
    boq_id = r.json()["id"]

    r = await authed_pm_client.get(f"/api/boqs/{boq_id}/items?page=1&page_size=10")
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = r.json()
    assert data["total"] == 25
    assert len(data["items"]) == 10
    assert data["items"][0]["line_number"] == 1
    assert data["items"][9]["line_number"] == 10

    r = await authed_pm_client.get(f"/api/boqs/{boq_id}/items?page=3&page_size=10")
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = r.json()
    assert len(data["items"]) == 5


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_soft_delete_version(authed_pm_client, test_project_id):
    items = _make_boq_json([_boq_item(1)])
    r = await authed_pm_client.post(
        f"/api/projects/{test_project_id}/boqs",
        files={"file": ("boq.json", items, "application/json")},
    )
    boq_id = r.json()["id"]

    r = await authed_pm_client.delete(f"/api/boqs/{boq_id}")
    assert r.status_code == 204

    r = await authed_pm_client.get(f"/api/projects/{test_project_id}/boqs")
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = r.json()
    assert data["total"] == 0
    assert len(data["items"]) == 0


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_viewer_can_view_but_not_delete(authed_viewer_client, test_project_id):
    items = _make_boq_json([_boq_item(1)])

Here's the comprehensive project analysis:

---

## SWA-ERP Project Status Analysis

### What's Shipped (Commits on `main`)

| Wave | Name | Status | Commit | Tests |
|------|------|--------|--------|-------|
| 1 | Foundation | **SHIPPED** | `df1b779` | auth, users, skeleton |
| 2 | Clients + Projects | **SHIPPED** | `d1e3017` | 52 tests (clients, projects, lifecycle, stats) |
| 3 | Quotation/BOQ | **SHIPPED** | (code exists, no commit?) | 1 test file (boq_versions) |
| 4 | Task Management | Partial | — | No tests |
| 5 | Vendors + Inventory | Partial | — | No tests |
| 6 | Documents + Compliance | Partial | — | 1 test file (compliance) |
| 7 | Time + Financials | Partial | — | 1 report (invoicing) |
| 8 | Reports + Dashboards | Partial | — | 3 test files (reports_api, reports_service, exports) |

### Backend — What Exists

**Models (18 files):** All domain models are built:
`User, Client, Contact, Project, AuditLog, RefreshToken, BOQ, BOQItem, Quote, QuoteItem, Task, TaskComment, Vendor, VendorContact, Material, MaterialCategory, Document, DocumentFolder, RFQ, RFQItem, TimeEntry, Timesheet, TimesheetAuditLog, Invoice, InvoiceItem, ProjectCost, ComplianceStandard, ComplianceChecklistItem, ProjectComplianceItem`

**APIs (20 routers):** All wired in `main.py`:
`auth, users, clients, projects, lifecycle, tasks, boqs, quotes, vendors, materials, rfqs, documents, compliance, invoices, time_tracking, timesheets, project_pnl, reports, dashboard, exports, health`

**Services (22 files):** Full business logic layer for all domains.

**Schemas (19 files):** Pydantic v2 schemas for all API surfaces.

**Repositories (19 files):** DB access layer for all models.

### Frontend — What Exists

**Pages (14):** `Login, Dashboard, Users, Clients (list/detail/new), Projects (list/detail/new), Vendors (list/detail/new), Compliance, Documents`

**Components (52):** Layout (AppShell/Sidebar/Topbar), Auth (ProtectedRoute), Dashboard (StatsCards/RecentProjects/RecentClients/QuickActions), Projects (Form/List/Detail), Clients (Form/List/ContactForm), BOQs (Upload/VersionList/ItemTable), Quotes (Builder/Detail/List/Actions), Tasks (KanbanBoard/TaskCard/TaskDetail), Vendors (Form/List/Detail/ContactForm), Compliance (Dashboard/Checklist/ItemStatus), Financials (InvoiceList/InvoiceDetail/CostEntryForm/PnlDashboard), Time (EntryForm/EntryList/TimesheetView/TimesheetSummary), UI primitives (button/card/dialog/badge/table/tabs/select/input/textarea/label/progress/skeleton)

### What's Missing / Incomplete

1. **Alembic migrations** — `alembic/versions/` directory doesn't exist. No migration files despite schema being created via `Base.metadata.create_all()`. Risk: production schema drift.

2. **Frontend routes incomplete** — `App.tsx` only has routes for: Login, Dashboard, Users, Clients, Projects, Documents. **Missing routes for:** Vendors, Compliance, Tasks/Kanban, Quotes, BOQs, Invoices, Time Tracking, Reports. These pages exist as files but aren't wired into routing.

3. **No tests for waves 4, 5, 7** — Test directories are empty or nonexistent. Wave 3 has 1 test file. Wave 6 has 1 test file (605 lines). Wave 8 has 3 test files.

4. **Wave-3 dispatch status** — `EXECUTION.md` says wave-3 is "READY TO DISPATCH" but all 5 task briefs exist and all 5 worker reports exist in `work/reports/wave-3/`. Code appears implemented (BOQ API, Quotes API, etc.) but never committed/shipped per the changelog.

5. **Wave-4 through wave-8** — All task briefs (`work/wave-N/`) exist. Worker reports exist for some (wave-4 has 1 report, wave-7 has 1 report). No wave-level commits.

6. **No `tests/unit/` or `tests/integration/`** — Makefile references these but directories don't exist.

7. **No `.specify/specs/` directory** — Despite `EXECUTION.md` referencing spec files.

### Overall Completion State

| Layer | Completion | Notes |
|-------|-----------|-------|
| **Models** | ~95% | All domain entities exist |
| **APIs** | ~90% | All routers exist and are mounted |
| **Services** | ~90% | All business logic implemented |
| **Schemas** | ~90% | Full Pydantic v2 coverage |
| **Repositories** | ~90% | Full DB access layer |
| **Tests** | ~30% | Only waves 1-2 are solid. Waves 3,6,8 have partial tests. Waves 4,5,7 have none |
| **Frontend pages** | ~70% | 14 pages exist but only ~6 are routed in App.tsx |
| **Frontend components** | ~80% | Rich component library for all domains |
| **Alembic migrations** | 0% | Not set up |
| **Wave shipping** | 2/8 | Only waves 1-2 committed to main |

**Bottom line:** The backend is ~90% implemented across all 8 waves (models, APIs, services, schemas, repositories). The frontend has ~70% of pages built. The critical gaps are: (1) Alembic migrations not created, (2) frontend routing covers only ~6 of 14 pages, (3) test coverage is sparse after wave-2, and (4) waves 3-8 code exists but hasn't been committed/shipped.
